[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (34.3→36.4) + 과매도 탈출 시도, 약한 상승 방향성
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0011→-0.0005) + 개선 중, 약세 수렴

[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($0.18) + 현재가와 일치, 돌파 시 단기 반등 기대

· 거래량 비율 (5일 평균 대비 1.01배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 보통
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 0.17 지지 확인 시 매수, 0.18 저항 돌파 시 매수 강화 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.18) vs SMA5 ($0.18)/SMA20 ($0.19)/SMA50 ($0.22): Short-term trend near mid-band, below mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.21): Below long-term trend, weak.
· 52-week position (9.2%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.3→36.4) + Attempting to exit oversold, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0011→-0.0005) + Improving, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $0.17, Mid $0.19): Approaching lower band, band width 24.19% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.17) + Based on 5-day/20-day lows.
· Swing resistance ($0.18) + Aligned with current price, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming) + Recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.01x vs 5-day average) + Moderate conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Buy on confirmation of $0.17 support, stronger buy on breaking $0.18 resistance.
